params.name: lookback_days
params.description: Number of days to look back (1-30)

params.name: include_processed
params.description: Whether to include already processed events in reconciliation

items.docs:
Reconcile Stripe events with local database for the specified lookback period.

This endpoint fetches Stripe events for the specified period and verifies that they have been
properly processed and applied to the local database. It can identify and fix:

- Missing subscription records
- Incorrect plan assignments
- Missing payment/invoice activities
- Orphaned subscription records
- Credit balance mismatches

Args:
    lookback_days: Number of days to look back for events (max 30 due to Stripe AP
